FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.Q1: How do I start identifying fonts with Find Font From Image?
FAQ.A1: Click 'Upload', choose an image with text, and let our AI analyze the lettering. Clearer images lead to more accurate matches.
FAQ.Q2: Can I upload images with multiple fonts?
FAQ.A2: Yes. Highlight the specific area you want to analyze, or run multiple uploads for each font you need.
FAQ.Q3: What's included in the free trial?
FAQ.A3: You receive 5 free credits to test single-image lookups, review font suggestions, and export basic reports.
FAQ.Q4: How do I cancel my subscription?
FAQ.A4: Email our support team at support@findfontfromimage.com. Your plan remains active until the end of your billing period—no additional charges or hidden fees.
FAQ.A5: Choose from flexible monthly, annual, or pay-as-you-go credit packs to fit your project pipeline.
FAQ.Q6: Which plan offers the best value?
FAQ.A6: Annual subscriptions deliver the lowest cost per lookup—ideal for agencies and in-house teams handling frequent requests.
